notes.title: THE GAME IS READY BOIS! RUNGORE 1.0 IS HERE
notes.content:
After 2 (two) years of development, many challenges tackled, all the turmoil and blood and tears... RUNGORE is finally being summoned to this world in its final form. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42897806/f0512109603ff5986034cbcd3b97b0df4a8a1313.png

New stuff:

1. Final level added - Meat Pit
And yes, you can actually reach it

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42897806/a551d8b1aae6940cb66be798a2f486e6862d2d3d.png

This update sets a record on the amount of content it adds. It alone adds adds this many artifacts

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42897806/b49b9c40cb743935d0eada3d0bfc79368b4758fe.png

2. New Game+
All levels in a row without resets, with ever increasing stats of all the mobs. A true challenge for true chads

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42897806/c667981f30b7c41cf9ed4719d1ad585e299a74bf.gif

Avarage run in ng+ be like

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42897806/f6fa3f28529977aa7aee81698c1fb42e5a4cfef8.png

3. New hero - Stance Guy
Prides himself for his martial arts prowess. Secretly wishes he could be as cool as Megachad Guy and just smack things to death.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42897806/e29086dd7a2eab83c12253c7f1aab7410b661ed9.png

4. Controller support
The most anticipated feature. You are welcome

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42897806/13a49f910d0e77cd8340ac5e1b4f855341b2ab7d.png

5. Big QOL change
We finally figured out how to handle thousands of cards in player's hand. Now you have an option to stacks them it their neat little piles, so that your hand will remain organized no matter what

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42897806/19170906ece0da5a69a053ccab96a478e130fe9a.gif

6. Midgame rebalance
Our trusted sources relayed to us that our midgame was sad and cringe. We fixed that.

 New cool music
 Enemies nerfed 
 Events don't make you miserable anymore
 Shader is tuned up
 Cursed cards were changed


7. Chinese localization
We take our localization endeavors extremely seriously. We took all the feedback we got after the EA release and fixed it as much as we could

8. Achievements
Gotta catch em all.
All 28 of them. 
Good luck ^-^

notes.title: RUNGORE Devlog 06.08.2023
notes.content:
Heyo people, devlog arrived

So, the last month was all over the place, but we are steadily moving forward. 10 out of 15 levels are made and a couple new mechanics are added. 

Right now i see a shift with how we design stuff.
During early stage of the game we had a lot of restrictions in mob design, because its sort of difficult to not overwhelm the player from the start when the game has such a unique gameplay. Right now we are designing levels at which the player would be accustomed to the RUNGORE environment, and so all breaks are off.
We have such insane battles now... Just... Be prepared to get trolled by game mechanics repeatedly on full release

So, the stuff that i can actually show you:

1. Cursed cards
They mess up your hand, they actively move to your mouse and they try to get played against your will. They will most likely kill you

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884911/9b047314a7f4bc8f8493eeb8ff61b749b42b6471.gif

2. Zalgo!
I've spent weeks trying to add Zalgo text support to our font. But it turned out to be impossible. Those cursed fonts work best in browser, they somewhat work in text editors, and they don't work at all in our engine. It has something to do with how text rendering code is set up and how it exactly interacts with UTF-8 encoding *blah-blah-blah nerd stuff*.
So we decided to imitate it with code anyway because its cool

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884911/8aa90a315ef1201944b209c7bea10a02ba7ea49a.gif

3. BOMBS
BOMS ARE THE BEST. I LIKE BOMBS. BOMBS DO BOOM. BOMBS MAKE SOFTLOCKS.
So yeah, we made a couple new ones. Fast bombs, mines, healing bombs, resurrecting bombs and -my favorite- fast resurrecting bombs. When you place them just right they do insane stuff

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884911/aa2e381474eccdcbce7a61827105b7d52e5d148a.gif

stay tuned, folks, there is more to come. Also, don't forget to wishlist the full game
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2113040/RUNGORE/

notes.title: RUNGORE Devlog 06.04.2023
notes.content:
And so the new era has begun in RUNGORE development. It is the era of "doing the same thing many times", which means that new enemies get drawn, new neutral events get implemented, and then we shoot more ideas for more enemies and events. Basically we want to finish all the levels first and then do everything else. 

The highlights of the last month are:

1. A lot of new enemies are drawn
Almost all of them are implemented by now. And yes, that ballista has arms, your eyes didn't deceive you

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884911/fa07ad5fe24a66ecc02b8817e83f4597c19da04e.gif

2. New level trait - radiation
It takes your hp away constantly, but also applies poison to enemies at the start of battle. Double-edged sword kind of thing. 
And apparently we got inspired by Undertale as well, that's why radiation damages you during card picks and events too. It makes the gameplay very tense (which is cool). 
Also don't worry, there will only be 2 levels with radiation overall.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884911/412c75924e3fbac467c4fb40969c64651a6453d0.gif

3. Another level trait - character swap
It is in very early stage right now, we are still testing it out. 
What's cool about the swap is that you can play with a character that has artifacts of another character. Dodge for every card on Knight Guy? I say yes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884911/94052b9173007b6f7e00ed5aead0bf686ca28acd.gif

Okay that's it folks. Stay tuned, there is more to come

notes.title: RUNGORE Devlog 06.12.2022
notes.content:
Heyo everyone, its that time of the month again. Devlog time.

So, during the last month we focused on getting all the menus in the game operational.
Right now we have shop, bestiary, mission screens, as well as map and hub areas in working order.

1. THE SHOP
Expanding on last month's shop update: shop graphics are done now, and also you will be able to buy one-time-use level modifications in there 

So yeah, with how the game code is set up, it appears that its really easy to put a couple extra neutral events in the level. Or to force a game breaking hero swap in any level. Or to make next level have turn-based combat. Yup. We have a slay-the-spire potion in there. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884911/33727dd8f130050ff517b0fd19db7ce3322a8344.png

2. THE BESTIARY
It should have been called "encyclopedia" or something, since we pumped every bit or information about the game in there. You will be able to check out cards, character descriptions, artifacts, gear, enemies, and maybe even random lore about the game world. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884911/84b2f8437017b649d1c1ff5157b9098cad14ac95.gif

3. THE MAP
So, i can't really say much about the game world right now, except that we decided to fully imitate fog of war for a ^-^ r e a s o n ^-^ You will be uncovering more and more of the map the more levels you complete

4. THE HUB
This is a character select screen. Also its a place where all the characters hang out, and as you progress more through the game you will see new heroes added to the pile and interact with each other. Very cool.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884911/f2985a872c5f04a97e703443fa7c757d2cb4e79e.gif

notes.title: RUNGORE Devlog 06.11.2022
notes.content:
Hey-hey people, another update is here.
Slowly but steadily we make the full game. During last month we accomplished:

- All heroes' visual design is done. 
Now you can see all the guys that we are planning to implement

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884911/85fb6a3102efa284b145836a87de354c8fb55449.png

Animations are there as well, but in more primitive version for testing purposes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884911/e581cfce7e6cbb4a55eb342423f3d8d900275617.gif

Yeah, test graphics do be looking like that sometimes.

- Pet system is undergoing early testing
Pets introduce another layer of hectic card-throwing to the game. Basically, pets give you another deck of cards to play with, where number-of-pets = number-of-cards that you can use in battle. Each pet card gets back to your hand instantly after being used, and you pay with your HP to keep playing them.
You can block this damage of course, so now you can strategize not only about how to kill your enemies, but also about how to not kill yourself. Very cool.

Right now we have 2 pets fully animated, and first draft of pet deck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884911/ea602e34496766c97e63724a4a2158f42ad70841.gif

- Meta progression via in-game shop
No NFTs in there, sadly. But you will be able to buy communism (which unlocks all other upgrades).
We have a unique economy system planned already, which we will be implementing soon. Not much more to say for now though.

notes.title: RUNGORE Devlog 06.10.2022
notes.content:
Making a game is like building a house: if its foundation is cringe, the whole house will turn out cringe. And that's why we spent whole month writing documentation and planning stuff.

I divided progress for this month into two parts:

Exciting stuff

1. RUNGORE UI 2.0
We are in the middle of revamping UI, so that gaming experience will be even more comfortable. We updated enemy info screen, changed the font, card icons and many more
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884911/7658472aa2273b421f1ce7ae402948fb966db470.png

2. Added bullet time on a press of a button

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42884911/de2eafabb61623cd45c204faa65b01a3d97ab038.gif

3. Optimization
There was a bug on a lot laptops which caused quite bit of lag. We fixed it ^-^

4. Another cool things
- Playing cards with number keys (just like in Slay the Spire)
- You don't need to use cards to change your target anymore
- Sorting cards can be done at any time

2. Not exciting stuff

So, we wrote A LOT of documentation. All heroes' mechanics are finalized on paper, as well as all level mechanics and themes. We are planning to make a total of ~75 new mobs and ~35 new bosses for the full release. 

Also there is lore. Yup. No one saw it coming

So stay tuned, folks. New content coming soon, really soon.
